home.heroDesc: A non-political, sovereign citizen movement for the dignity, cultural pride, and constitutional rights of Odisha.
home.founderQuote: “Odisha has given so much to India — yet its people still wait for the opportunities, dignity, and development they deserve. Our youth leave for other cities, our farmers face uncertain incomes, and our daughters deserve more than advice to be careful — they deserve institutions that protect their dignity and freedom. Odisha Swabhiman Defender was born from these realities: the belief that Odisha's next chapter should be written by honest hands and capable minds, not waited for but built. This is not about one person — it is about a generation of Odias building the future together.”
home.missionDesc: To build a clean, capable, and accountable citizen movement for Odisha — restoring Swabhiman through honest civic action, real economic opportunity, quality education, accessible healthcare, and leadership that answers to the people, not to dynasties or vested interests.
home.visionDesc: An Odisha where no one has to leave home for work, every child gets quality education, no family fears an illness, farmers and workers share fairly in prosperity, every woman moves through public life without fear, and coastal and tribal communities are protected — not left behind.
home.councilDesc: Steered by renowned Jurists, Historians, Educators, and Grassroots Reformers actively defending constitutional rights across all 30 districts of Odisha.
home.whyReason1Desc: Solely dedicated to the constitutional welfare and cultural pride of Odisha.
home.whyReason2Desc: Official verified identity card with QR signature and district assignment.
home.whyReason3Desc: Free RTI assistance, public petition filing, and community-led legal defence.
home.standDesc: Join citizens across Odisha committed to cultural preservation and civic empowerment.
home.zeroFeeBadge: Zero fee • Direct digital citizen badge
home.statutoryNoticeDesc: Odisha Swabhiman Defender (OSD) is a citizen movement and is not a registered political party. We do not field electoral candidates.

OSD-VOL.title: Volunteer
OSD-VOL.desc: Grassroots events, cultural rallies, and community outreach.
OSD-VOL.whatYouDo: Assisting in cultural events, signature campaigns, relief distribution, and Odia pride rallies.
OSD-VOL.whoSuits: Any resident of Odisha with dedication to social service and community welfare.

OSD-PM.title: Primary Member
OSD-PM.desc: Civic advocacy supporter, regional resolution participant.
OSD-PM.whatYouDo: Participating in local chapter assemblies, supporting civic campaigns, and spreading awareness.
OSD-PM.whoSuits: Citizens who want formal recognition and active standing in the movement.

OSD-AM.title: Active Member
OSD-AM.desc: Weekly community engagement & town hall deliberation desks.
OSD-AM.whatYouDo: Weekly civic vigilance desks, town halls, RTI empowerment drives, and local workshops.
OSD-AM.whoSuits: Grassroots community organizers, youth & professionals able to commit 4+ hours monthly.

OSD-COORD.title: Local Coordinator
OSD-COORD.desc: Direct Block & Ward level volunteer mobilization leader.
OSD-COORD.whatYouDo: Leading block and ward volunteers, organizing local meetings, and routing citizen grievances.
OSD-COORD.whoSuits: Respected local organizers with team-building ability and strong grassroots presence.

OSD-LDR.title: Committee / Leadership Aspirant
OSD-LDR.desc: Strategic planning, campaign design & inter-district sync.
OSD-LDR.whatYouDo: Developing district action plans, training block coordinators, and policy research.
OSD-LDR.whoSuits: Emerging civic leaders and dedicated defenders with proven mobilization track records.

OSD-SUP.title: Supporter
OSD-SUP.desc: Digital amplifier, media evangelist & philanthropic advocate.
OSD-SUP.whatYouDo: Amplifying movement messages on social channels, fact-checking, and digital advocacy.
OSD-SUP.whoSuits: Students, digital creators, and Odia diaspora supporters wanting to lend digital strength.

OSD-FC.title: Founding Circle
OSD-FC.desc: Civic patron, initial guarantor & ideological archivist.
OSD-FC.whatYouDo: Steering the movement's founding values, preserving history, and ethics oversight.
OSD-FC.whoSuits: Pioneering figures, community elders, and foundational supporters of the movement.

OSD-PE.title: Professional Expert
OSD-PE.desc: Legal, technology, healthcare, environmental & heritage advisor.
OSD-PE.whatYouDo: Providing pro-bono legal aid, RTI drafting, health camps, environmental audits, and technical systems.
OSD-PE.whoSuits: Advocates, doctors, engineers, professors, environmentalists, and administrative experts.

OSD-AC.title: Advisory Council
OSD-AC.desc: Venerable state dignitaries, retired jurists, and Padma laureates.
OSD-AC.whatYouDo: Guiding constitutional questions, state-level summits, and ethical guardianship.
OSD-AC.whoSuits: Conferred exclusively by Super Admin nomination.

application.profDeclarationText: Working-Professionals & Neutrality Declaration: I hereby declare that my association with OSD is strictly civic and non-electoral, and does not conflict with any official professional ethics or institutional service conduct rules.
application.oathDeclarationText: I affirm that I am a resident/native of Odisha, dedicated to the protection of Odia language, heritage, and the constitutional rights of the citizens. (ମୁଁ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଜଣେ ବାସିନ୍ଦା ଏବଂ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭାଷା, ସଂସ୍କୃତି ତଥା ସାମ୍ବିଧାନିକ ଅଧିକାର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରତିବଦ୍ଧ।)
application.transferConsentText: I agree my details may be used by OSD Connect, and may be transferred to a successor political organisation only with my separate consent. (ମୁଁ ସହମତ ଯେ ମୋର ବିବରଣୀ ଓଏସଡି ଦ୍ୱାରା ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୋଇପାରିବ ଏବଂ କେବଳ ମୋର ପୃଥକ ସହମତି ସହିତ କୌଣସି ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀ ରାଜନୈତିକ ସଂଗଠନକୁ ହସ୍ତାନ୍ତର କରାଯାଇପାରିବ।)
